title: Existence Conditions
description: Essential Criteria: The conditions E <= cB and cB <= E must be correctly stated for the existence of Lorentz frames.

title: Motion Description
description: Important Criteria: The description of the particle's motion in the frame where E = 0 must include the correct equations and indicate circular motion.

title: Momentum Function
description: Essential Criteria: The momentum as a function of time must be correctly derived and expressed for the frame with B = 0.

title: Circular Motion Radius
description: Optional Criteria: The radius of circular motion R must be correctly derived and presented.

title: Sign Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: Common errors include incorrect signs in the equations or misinterpretation of the direction of forces.

title: Unit Consistency
description: Pitfall Criteria: Ensure that all units are consistent throughout the calculations, particularly in the momentum equations.
